name: Design a feedback loop
short_description: Define a measurable attempt, evidence source, correction rule, and next attempt for one skill.
self_assessment: I can design a four-part feedback loop for one skill without help.
description: Define a measurable attempt, evidence source, correction rule, and next attempt for one skill. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
examples: Design a loop for improving a timed explanation

builds_on.note: Specific feedback supports actionable correction rules.
